title: hedyotis biflora var. graminicola
intro: Hedyotis biflora var. graminicola, commonly known as the 'Gramineous Hedyotis', is a plant species within the Rubiaceae family, characterized by its grass-like appearance and medicinal properties. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Hedyotis biflora var. graminicola include its ability to calm the respiratory system, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
